cases.prompt: Initialize fixtures/project with the packaged woostack-init procedure in --no-clobber mode. First validate every field in fixtures/receipts/success.json while performing zero target-project filesystem or Git access. Only after that succeeds may you inspect fixtures/project, preserve its config byte-for-byte, create the remaining canonical knowledge/response/worktree/diagnostic pieces without specs, plans, or fixes, and run build-index. Then invoke exactly `bash fixtures/tools/doctor.sh --live-receipt fixtures/receipts/success.json fixtures/project`; never pass `.woostack/memory` as doctor's target. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, reasonCode, projectFilesystemAccessBeforePreflight, gitAccessBeforePreflight, writesStarted, createdPaths, skippedPaths, validationOrder, doctorInvocation, doctorTarget, doctorExitCode, configBeforeSha256, and configAfterSha256. Use exactly status `complete`, mode `no-clobber`, and reasonCode `ready`; equivalent tokens are invalid.
cases.expected: A complete normalized official host-MCP receipt alone clears preflight; no-clobber then repairs only non-authoritative stores, indexes memory, and calls doctor with --live-receipt and the repository root.
